The receipt records no tool attempts, executed_actions is empty, publication stays draft, recovery stays unknown and no mitigation or closure is invented.

criteria.rationale: The primary fresh bounded APM comparison and explicit recovery criteria are useful, but the conditional causal check and final handoff assume report-owned slow-trace detail can localize the delay or HTTP 503 origin. The complete supplied trace records gfev_ae1d7953855539d0ec694c4c35ac45ccd136ce6a5ee2f785027d938bc797bcfa and gfev_55c13cbffdcdb3deb211818061eb521efbfca2b37155bd52a7d79dec6d50c7b4 contain only timestamped EVENT summaries that a checkout trace exceeded 1000 ms, with no component, span breakdown or error-origin fields. The handoff should explicitly request an approved richer source and retain an evidence gap if it is unavailable rather than direct the responder to detail not established by this evidence contract.
